# controld_native_filters (Data Source)

Lists ControlD's native filter lists (e.g. malware, ads) and their current status for a profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_native_filters" "home" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile to list filters for.

### Read-Only

- `filters` (Attributes List) The list of filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source, equal to `profile_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The description of the filter.
- `name` (String) The filter identifier (PK), usable as `filter` in a `controld_filter` resource.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the filter is currently enabled.
